method: Scores (0-10) combine perspective breadth, severity wording, cross-source corroboration and momentum. They measure attention and concern in public reporting - not probability, not a forecast. Read the sources before acting.
summary: Scanned 422 items from 12 of 13 sources; 116 matched a perspective and were grouped into 110 distinct issues.
Top list ratings: High 3, Elevated 7 (9 threats, 1 watch items).
Momentum baseline still building (0 of 3 days collected).
Most widely reported: "FAA lifts nationwide ground stop on all US flights" (3 sources).
